question:
I'm trying to migrate from an ETL to DBT (dbt Core, using dbt-oracle) using SQL, for Oracle.

I'm wondering how I can insert (append) the final result of my dataflow into an already existing table (it can already have rows in it). Could someone give me some simple examples?

Ideally, I'd like to be able to only insert to specific columns, so not like a:

insert into tgt 
select * 
  from src

but rather like a:

insert into tgt (col1, col3, col5) 
select colA, colC, colE 
  from src

I tried things like

materialized='incremental', incremental_strategy='append', post-hooks, macros,

but it never worked:

  • with
{{ config(
    materialized='incremental',
    alias='tgt_tb',
    schema='tgt_sch'
) }}

it doubles the schema with the default schema as :

1 of 1 ERROR creating sql incremental model tgt_sch_tgt_sch.tgt_tb [ERROR in 0.71s]... ORA-00942: table or view does not exist

so it doesn't work.

  • if I name the model as the name of the tgt_tb (models/tgt_tb.sql):
{{ config( materialized='incremental' ) }}
select * from {{ ref('src_tb') }}

then I get this error:

Database Error in model tgt_tb(models/tgt_tb.sql) ORA-27090: Unable to reserve kernel resources for asynchronous disk I/O Linux-x86_64 Error: 2: No such file or directory Additional information: 3
Additional information: 128 Additional information: 140728887912876 ORA-00942: table or view does not exist

  • with
{{ config(
    materialized='incremental',
    alias='tgt_tb'
) }}

it doesn't double the schema, but I still have the error:

1 of 1 ERROR creating sql incremental model tgt_sch.tgt_tb [ERROR in 0.53s]... ORA-00942: table or view does not exist

  • with models/tgt_tb.sql:
{{ config(
    materialized='ephemeral'
) }}
select * from {{ ref('tgt_tb') }}

and dbt_project.yml:

models:
  my_oracle_dbt:
    tgt_tb:
      post-hook:
        - "insert /*+ append */ into tgt_sch.tgt_tb select * from {{ this }} "

(using a post-hook), there is no error, but nothing is inserted:

14:34:55 Found 4 models, 2 seeds, 8 data tests, 1 source, 489 macros 14:34:55 Concurrency: 1 threads (target='dev') 14:34:56 Finished running in 0 hours 0 minutes and 1.39 seconds

  • when I try a macro:
{% macro insert_tst() %}
    insert into tgt_sch.tgt_tb
    select *
    from {{ ref('src_tb') }}
{% endmacro %}

there is no error, but nothing runs?

14:06:28 [WARNING]: Configuration paths exist in your dbt_project.yml file which do not apply to any resources. There are 1 unused configuration paths: - models.my_oracle_dbt.example 14:06:28 Found 2 seeds, 4 models, 8 data tests, 1 source, 489 macros (.venv)

I may have done something wrong somewhere, but it's hard to know if a method is just wrongly done or will never work, since I don't know much about DBT.
title: Insert (append) into an already existing table with DBT for Oracle
answer:
The incremental strategy is what your looking for. Here's a basic example that insert the current_timestamp in our table tgt_tb :

File dummy_insert.sql

{{ config(
    materialized='incremental',
    alias='tgt_tb',
    incremental_strategy = "append",
    database = 'hive_metastore',
    schema = 'my_schema'
) }}

select current_timestamp() as insert_time

materialized must be one of : table, view, incremental, ephemeral, materialized view

alias aims at setting the name differently than your filename

incremental_strategy must be one of : append, merge, merge_update_columns, delete+insert, insert_overwrite,

database and schema self explain.

Command run twice :

dbt run  --select dummy_insert

Result :

select * result
